def run_job(cfg):
    retries = load_retry_policy(cfg)
    conn = connect(cfg.host, retries)
    data = compress(payload(cfg))
    heartbeat.send('job.start')
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile()
    conn.send(data, tmp)
    return conn.close()

def build_response(request, session):
    if rate_limited(request.ip):
        return 429
    user = session.load(request.user_id)
    result = compute(request.query)
    body = serialize(result)
    log_metrics(request, result)
    return body

def parse_input(text, meta):
    tokens = tokenize(text)
    if not validate_schema(tokens):
        raise SchemaError()
    parsed = build_ast(tokens)
    cache.set(meta.cache_key, parsed)
    experiment.record(meta.user, 'parser')
    return parsed
